title: Design System: Ralph Lauren B2B Boilerplate

_provenance.source: styles/brand.css, styles/styles.css, blocks/* of the Ralph Lauren B2B Boilerplate (derived from https://corporate.ralphlauren.com/)
_provenance.role: Locked Ralph Lauren standard. Cobranded microsites read this file; they never edit it. Partner rules: brand/rl/COBRAND-RULES.md.

display.purpose: Large statements on immersive sections; rare.

headline.purpose: Page titles (h1), uppercase. Hero titles: 44px desktop, 28px mobile, white.

label.purpose: Buttons, navigation, footer links, eyebrows (h6); uppercase.

motion.name: underline-grow
motion.purpose: Secondary link underline grows to full width on hover.

sectionStyles.narrow: Limit default content to the 790px reading measure.
sectionStyles.dark: Navy ground, white text; buttons invert.
sectionStyles.cobrand: Partner soft-tint ground (--cobrand-accent-soft); navy text and buttons stay.
sectionStyles.cobrand-accent: Partner accent ground (--cobrand-accent) with --cobrand-accent-contrast text; buttons invert to the contrast colour.

header.purpose: Brand row (ticker label, wordmark, search) and navigation row; optional partner lockup.

footer.purpose: Social, wordmark, optional partner line, primary and legal links, copyright.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action: navy block with a short rule beneath. Authored as a bold link.
components.css: .ds-btn-wrap { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 15px; color: #031e3a; } .ds-btn-wrap::after { content: ''; width: 112px; height: 1px; background: currentcolor; } .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; min-width: 263px; padding: 20px 26px; background: #031e3a; color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 1px; line-height: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0068d6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Link Button
components.description: Quiet uppercase text link with a short underline that grows on hover. Authored as an italic link.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-block; padding: 0 0 6px; color: #031e3a; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 2px; line-height: 28px; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(currentcolor, currentcolor) no-repeat center bottom / 5em 1px; transition: background-size 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { background-size: 100% 1px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Download / tertiary action: navy outline that fills on hover. Authored as a bold italic link.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; padding: 18px 26px; border: 1px solid #031e3a; color: #031e3a; background: transparent; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 1px; line-height: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { background: #031e3a; color: #fff; }

components.description: Desktop navigation row: nine uppercase mono links spread between quiet rules.

narrative.overview: The system is the Ralph Lauren corporate voice translated for business partners: the calm of a Madison Avenue flagship rather than the energy of a retail campaign. Photography carries the emotion; type, colour and layout stay composed and almost silent around it. Navy on white, a classic serif for headlines, a clean sans for reading and a small mono label for wayfinding are the whole vocabulary. Cobranded microsites inherit this system intact. A partner adds its logo, a restrained accent colour, its imagery and its page compositions, but it never changes the voice.
keyCharacteristics: Navy (#031e3a) on white is the default for text, buttons and rules.
Serif headlines, sans body, mono uppercase labels and buttons.
Centred, editorial layout with generous section spacing.
Full-bleed photography with white type over it.

rules.name: The One Navy Rule
rules.body: Navy is the only colour for body text and primary calls to action, on every site, cobranded or not.

rules.name: The Blue Is For Reading Rule
rules.body: Ledger Blue marks links inside running text and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif speaks, sans explains, mono directs. Never set body copy in the serif or headlines in the mono.

rules.name: The Quiet Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings stay at weight 400. Emphasis comes from size and case, never bold.

rules.name: The Centre Holds Rule
rules.body: Headings, short copy and calls to action are centred. Left alignment is for long reading text and lists inside columns.

rules.name: The Flat Flagship Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If an element needs separation, use a 1px rule or a section ground, never a shadow.

dos: Do set all body text and primary buttons in RL Navy (#031e3a) on white or Linen.
Do keep headings at weight 400 and let size and uppercase create hierarchy.
Do use full-bleed photography with a darkening overlay when white type sits on it.
Do centre headings, short copy and calls to action.
Do keep reading text within the 790px measure.
Do separate content with section grounds or 1px rules.
donts: Don't round corners on buttons, images or containers.
Don't add shadows, gradients or glass effects.
Don't use Ledger Blue for anything other than inline links.
Don't bold headings or set body copy in the serif.
Don't introduce new typefaces; the three families are the system.
Don't recolour the primary button for a partner; partner colour lives in accents only (COBRAND-RULES.md).
